Provides a resource to create an AGS sandbox tool.

> **Note:** `toolName`, `toolType`, `defaultTimeout`, `roleArn`, `storageMounts`, `logConfiguration` and `persistent` are create-only: the update API does not accept them, so changing any of them destroys the existing sandbox tool and creates a new one.

> **Note:** `defaultTimeout` is only accepted by the create API. The describe API reports the timeout in seconds (`DefaultTimeoutSeconds`) instead of the original duration string, so the value configured here is kept as it is and drift on it cannot be detected.

> **Note:** Removing `description`, `tags`, `customConfiguration`, `computerConfiguration` or `persistent` from the configuration keeps the value that currently exists on the cloud side, because the update API does not transmit empty values. To clear those attributes, delete and recreate the sandbox tool.

> **Note:** Destroying this resource deletes the sandbox tool itself only. It does not terminate sandbox instances that were created from the tool and it does not release any storage (COS bucket, CFS file system or volume) referenced by `storageMounts`.

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const custom = new tencentcloud.ags.SandboxTool("custom", {
    customConfiguration: {
        args: [
            "-port",
            "8080",
        ],
        commands: ["/bin/go-httpbin"],
        dnsConfig: null,
        envs: null,
        image: "ccr.ccs.tencentyun.com/test/go-httpbin:v2.16.1",
        imageRegistryType: "personal",
        ports: [{
            name: "http",
            port: 8080,
            protocol: "TCP",
        }],
        probe: {
            failureThreshold: 60,
            httpGet: {
                path: "/status/200",
                port: 8080,
                scheme: "HTTP",
            },
            probePeriodMs: 1000,
            probeTimeoutMs: 1000,
            readyTimeoutMs: 30000,
            successThreshold: 1,
        },
        resources: {
            cpu: "1",
            memory: "1Gi",
            storage: null,
        },
        securityContext: null,
    },
    defaultTimeout: null,
    description: "Guoning standard web sandbox: intranet TCR go-httpbin v2.16.1, 1C1Gi, HTTP /status/200:8080",
    logConfiguration: null,
    networkConfiguration: {
        networkMode: "PUBLIC",
        vpcConfig: null,
    },
    persistent: false,
    roleArn: "qcs::cam::uin/xxxxxx:roleName/cos-tcr-full-ags",
    storageMounts: null,
    toolName: toolName,
    toolType: "custom",
});
```

## Import



AGS sandbox tool can be imported using the sandbox tool id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Ags/sandboxTool:SandboxTool example tool-xxxxxxxx
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
